description:
Start fetching a link (or one file of a share, with `share_id` and `file_id`). Returns a job id; poll it
        with `get_job`. Uses no free file yet. A Quark or PikPak share with folders or several files starts no
        job: it answers status "pick_required" with its files, as `download` does.

file_id.description: The id of the one file to fetch, from the share's list
file_id.title: File Id

password.description: Extraction code / password, if the share has one
password.title: Password

share_id.description: From a pick_required answer: the share the file is in
share_id.title: Share Id

url.description: Share or file link from a supported site
url.title: Url

name: start_download
title: Start a download job
